title: Client kickoff call
lead: Is lesson ke baad tum kickoff call open kar sakte ho: scope, requirements, timeline poochho, next step confirm karo, aur summary bhejo.
description: Week 4 English lesson: open a client kickoff call, ask for requirements, agree a timeline, and confirm next steps.

patterns.note: Need ke baad noun ya to + verb.
patterns.say: We need the logo and content.
patterns.positive: We need the logo and content.
patterns.negative: We don't need a new domain.
patterns.question: What do we need for the kickoff?
examples: We need two weeks for development.
Humein development ke liye do hafte chahiye.
We need to confirm the scope first.
Humein pehle scope confirm karna hai.
patterns.grammar: need + noun; need + to + verb. He/she/it ke saath needs. Requirement clear rakho.
patterns.mistake: “We need to logo” → “We need the logo.” Noun ke pehle to nahi lagta.

patterns.note: I'd like = I would like; polite wish.
patterns.say: I'd like to start with the scope.
patterns.positive: I'd like to start with the scope.
patterns.negative: I wouldn't like to change the timeline.
patterns.question: What would you like to discuss first?
examples: I'd like to show you the first design.
Main aapko pehla design dikhana chahta hoon.
I'd like to ask two questions.
Main do sawaal poochhna chahta hoon.
patterns.grammar: I'd = I would. would like to + base verb = polite ‘I want’. Question: What would you like...?
patterns.mistake: “I would like start” → “I'd like to start.” would like ke baad to + base verb.

patterns.note: Polite request; share ke baad kya chahiye.
patterns.say: Could you share the brand guidelines?
patterns.positive: Could you share the brand guidelines?
patterns.negative: We can't share the client's data.
patterns.question: Could you share the reference site?
examples: Could you share the logo files?
Kya aap logo files share kar sakte hain?
Could you share it on WhatsApp?
Kya aap ise WhatsApp par share kar sakte hain?
patterns.grammar: Could you + base verb. share something with someone: share it with me.
patterns.mistake: “Could you share me the file?” → “Could you share the file with me?” share something with someone.

patterns.note: Let's = let us; suggestion jo team ko saath karta hai.
patterns.negative: Let's not add new features this week.
patterns.question: Should we start with the design?
examples: Let's start with the homepage.
Chalo homepage se shuru karte hain.
Let's meet again on Monday.
Chalo Monday ko dobara milte hain.
patterns.grammar: Let's + base verb. Negative: let's not + base verb. ‘Let's to’ kabhi nahi.
patterns.mistake: “Let's to confirm the timeline” → “Let's confirm the timeline.” Let's ke baad base verb.

patterns.note: Client ki preference poochhne ka polite question.
patterns.say: When would you like the first draft?
patterns.positive: When would you like the first draft?
patterns.negative: I'm not sure when I can send it.
patterns.question: When would you like to meet next?
examples: When would you like to start?
Aap kab shuru karna chahenge?
When would you like the final payment?
Aap final payment kab chahenge?
patterns.grammar: When would you like + noun / to + verb. Question word + would + subject + like.
patterns.mistake: “When you would like to meet?” → “When would you like to meet?” Subject se pehle would.

patterns.note: Next step promise karne ke liye.
patterns.say: I'll send you the summary by evening.
patterns.positive: I'll send you the summary by evening.
patterns.negative: I won't send the final file today.
patterns.question: Should I send you the summary?
examples: I'll send you the invoice tomorrow.
Main aapko kal invoice bhej doonga.
I'll send you the file after the call.
Main call ke baad file bhej doonga.
patterns.grammar: I'll = I will. Promise ya next step. send someone something; by + deadline.
patterns.mistake: “I will send to you the file” → “I'll send you the file.” send + person + thing.

grammarRules: We need the logo. We need to confirm.
I'd like to start with the scope.
Could you + base verb for polite requests
Let's + base verb; Let's not + base verb
will / 'll for promises and next steps
I'll send you the file by Friday.
mistakes: would like ke baad to + base verb.
I will send to you the file.
When you would like to meet?
When would you like to meet?
Could you share me the file?
Could you share the file with me?

dialogue.context: Client kickoff call. Riya = client, You = developer. Scope, timeline aur next step cover karo.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: Thanks for joining. Shall we start?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Yes. I'd like to start with the scope. We need the logo and content.

lines.speaker: Riya
lines.text: Sure. When would you like them?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: By Wednesday, if possible. Could you share the brand guidelines?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Great. Let's confirm the timeline, and I'll send you the summary.

dialogue.closing: Kickoff me teen cheezein: scope, timeline, next step. Call ke end me summary zaroor bolo.

speakPrompts.title: 1. Open the call
speakPrompts.starter: Thanks for joining. I'd like to start with ___ .

speakPrompts.title: 2. Ask for what you need
speakPrompts.starter: We need ___ and ___ . Could you share ___ ?

speakPrompts.title: 3. Agree the timeline
speakPrompts.starter: Let's confirm ___ . When would you like ___ ?

speakPrompts.title: 4. Close with next steps
speakPrompts.starter: I'll send you ___ . Let's meet on ___ .

pronunciation.title: Contractions
pronunciation.body: I'd = /aɪd/, let's = /lets/, we'll = /wiːl/. Fast speech me yahi natural hai — full forms thode formal lagte hain.

pronunciation.title: Linking
pronunciation.body: Would you → /wʊdʒə/. Share it → /ʃeərɪt/. Words ko jodo, ek ek karke mat todo.

pronunciation.title: by + deadline
pronunciation.body: by = /baɪ/, buy jaisa. “by Friday” me Friday par stress: by FRIDAY.

pronunciation.title: deliverable
pronunciation.body: de-LIV-er-a-ble — stress second syllable par. Char syllables ko equal mat bolo.

followUps: Kickoff call me scope kaise aur clearly poochhun?
“I'd like to” aur “I want to” me kya difference hai?
Client ko timeline push back karna ho to kaise bolun?
Meri “Could you share” line polite thi ya direct?
Kickoff summary ka best 5-line structure kya hai?
mission: Ek 5-line kickoff summary voice note record karo: scope, timeline, do questions, next step.
